degraded.title: Some things couldn't come across
degraded.scripts: Your page had parts built with JavaScript — things like counters, carousels or interactive buttons. OpenLen removes those for safety. You can rebuild them with Modules.
degraded.embeds: Content embedded from other sites (videos or maps) was removed. You can add it back with Modules.
degraded.unsafe_links: Some links weren't safe to keep, so they were removed.
degraded.dynamic_content: Part of what your page builds by itself may look empty. You can write it in directly in the editor.
degraded.broken_controls: Some interactive controls were wired incorrectly and won't work. Ask the assistant to fix them.
degraded.handlers_lost: This template wired some buttons in a way that doesn't survive cloning. The code is still on your page — what was lost is the wiring, so those buttons won't do anything. Ask the assistant to reconnect them.
degraded.form_routing_stale: Some of your form settings (which email gets notified, where it redirects) may have stopped applying after this edit. Check each form still notifies where you want.
degraded.runtime_stale: Your page's code looks for things that aren't there, so it stopped working entirely — not just that part. Ask the chat to fix it.
